title: The Mending of the Multiverse
summary: The restoration of reality fundamentally changes the nature of planeswalkers.
narrative: The repair of Dominaria’s temporal rifts required the intervention and sacrifice of several powerful figures, including Freyalise and Lord Windgrace.
The final restoration, associated with Jeska’s actions, transformed the nature of the planeswalker spark and ended the era of near-omnipotent oldwalkers.
